headlines.title_en: Central bank: Reclassify prepaid card issuance and processing as stored-value account operations type II business

headlines.title: 香港证监会优化单日杠杆及反向产品的监管框架以确保市场有序交易
headlines.summary: 香港证监会今天发出经修订的通函，将规定其容量高度受市况变化影响的杠杆及反向产品，须采用灵活杠杆结构。在此结构下，杠杆倍数可在现有上限（即杠杆产品为2倍，反向产品为-2倍）内每日调整。因此，产品提供者在必要时可下调该等产品的目标杠杆倍数，从而于高交易量期间有更大空间管理产品。该等产品于下一交易日的杠杆倍数将于每日收市后披露。杠杆倍数每日的潜在调整，亦有助加深投资者对杠杆及反向产品属单日产品的认识，提醒投资者该等产品并不适合持有超过一日。（香港证监会网站）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC optimizes regulatory framework for single-day leveraged and inverse products to ensure orderly market trading
headlines.summary_en: Today, the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission issued a revised circular requiring leveraged and inverse products, whose capacity is highly susceptible to market condition changes, to adopt a flexible leverage structure. Under this structure, the leverage ratio can be adjusted daily within the existing caps (i.e., 2x for leveraged products and -2x for inverse products). Therefore, product providers can lower the target leverage ratio of these products when necessary, allowing greater room to manage the product during high-volume trading periods. The leverage ratio for the next trading day will be disclosed after each day's close. The potential daily adjustment of the leverage ratio also helps deepen investor understanding that leveraged and inverse products are single-day products, reminding investors that these products are not suitable for holding beyond one day. (SFC website)

headlines.title: 两部门：居民个人装入财产的离岸信托存续期间产生的收益 适用20%税率
headlines.summary: 近日，财政部、税务总局发布了《关于离岸信托征收个人所得税有关事项的公告》。财政部税政司、税务总局所得税司有关负责人就此回答了记者提问。 其中提到，对于居民个人装入财产的离岸信托存续期间产生的收益，以居民个人为纳税人，根据收益性质分别按照“财产转让所得”和“利息、股息、红利所得”，按年计算缴纳个人所得税，适用20%税率。其中，“财产转让所得”按照转让股权、股票、房产等财产收入额扣除财产原值和合理费用后的余额计算，在一个年度内的盈利和损失额可以互抵，但损失额不得结转以后年度；“利息、股息、红利所得”按照利息股息红利等其他各项所得总和计算。

headlines.title_en: Two ministries: Income generated during the existence of offshore trusts where residents place personal property applies a 20% tax rate
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the Ministry of Finance and the State Administration of Taxation issued an 'Announcement on Matters Concerning the Collection of Individual Income Tax on Offshore Trusts.' Officials from the Ministry of Finance's Tax Policy Department and the State Administration of Taxation's Income Tax Department answered reporters' questions on this matter. It mentions that for income generated during the existence of an offshore trust funded by a resident individual's property, the resident individual is the taxpayer. The income is classified annually as 'income from property transfer' or 'interest, dividends, and bonus income,' subject to a 20% individual income tax rate. 'Income from property transfer' is calculated based on the proceeds from transferring property such as equity, stocks, and real estate, minus the original cost of the property and reasonable expenses. Gains and losses within a tax year can be offset against each other, but losses cannot be carried forward to subsequent years. 'Interest, dividends, and bonus income' is calculated based on the total of various other incomes such as interest, dividends, and bonuses.

headlines.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Tariff wars and trade wars do not serve the interests of any party
headlines.summary_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Lin Jian presided over a regular press conference. A reporter asked: The US's latest round of tariff measures will take effect today, does the Foreign Ministry have any comment? Lin Jian stated that China's position on China-US economic and trade issues is consistent and clear, opposing all forms of unilateral tariff measures, as tariff wars and trade wars benefit no party. headlines.title_en: A-share market close: Shanghai Composite Index falls 1.61%, approaching 3800 points, total market turnover below 2 trillion
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market generally adjusted with shrinking volume, and all three major indices fell sharply. The defense sector was actively moving against the trend, with Great Wall Defense hitting its 2nd consecutive daily limit up. Companies like ARCTIC WOLF (Zhongguang Fanglei) and Jianshe Industrial also hit their daily limits up. The semiconductor chip sector picked up intraday, with Torrence hitting its 4th daily limit up in 5 days, and Zhichun Technology and Beiling Jicheng also hitting daily limits up. On the downside, the entire power sector corrected, with multiple stocks like Jingneng Electric Power, Shenzhen Nandian A, Yuedian Power A, and Datang Power hitting daily limits down. Stocks broadly declined, with nearly 5,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets falling. Today's turnover was 1.94 trillion yuan, falling below 2 trillion for the first time since April 7, 2026. At the close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.61%, the Shenzhen Component fell 2.47%, and the ChiNext fell 2.65%. 2. By sector concept, only a few sectors like Electronic Specialty Gas and HBM were in the green, while sectors like Precious Metals, Electric Power, Coal, and Pharmaceuticals fell the most. 3. A total of 534 stocks across the two cities rose, with 42 stocks hitting their daily limits up.

headlines.title: 商务部新闻发言人就将14家欧盟实体列入出口管制管控名单答记者问
headlines.summary: 北京时间7月23日晚，欧方正式发布第21轮对俄制裁措施，将14家中国内地和香港企业列单制裁。为维护国家安全和利益，履行防扩散等国际义务，针对欧方上述恶劣行径，根据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》和《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》等法律法规有关规定，中方决定将拉法特集团等14家欧盟实体列入出口管制管控名单，禁止出口经营者向上述实体出口两用物项，禁止境外组织和个人将原产于中华人民共和国的两用物项转移或提供给上述实体。（商务部网站）

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM spokesperson answers press questions on adding 14 EU entities to export control list
headlines.summary_en: On the evening of July 23, Beijing time, the EU officially released its 21st round of sanctions against Russia, listing 14 Chinese mainland and Hong Kong companies on the sanctions list. To safeguard national security and interests, fulfill international obligations such as non-proliferation, and in response to the EU's aforementioned despicable act, in accordance with relevant laws and regulations including the 'Export Control Law of the People's Republic of China' and the 'Regulations on the Export Control of Dual-Use Items of the People's Republic of China', China has decided to place 14 EU entities, including Rafat Group, on the export control list, prohibiting export operators from exporting dual-use items to these entities, and prohibiting foreign organizations and individuals from transferring or providing dual-use items originating from the People's Republic of China to these entities. (Ministry of Commerce website)
